steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A design brief defines the problem — who is the audience, what is the message, what are the constraints. | Key Fact: The design process is iterative: research, ideas, development, refinement, feedback, revision. | Key Fact: Mind-mapping and mood boards help generate and organise ideas visually at the start of a project. | Key Fact: Presenting to a client requires clear rationale — explain design decisions, not just show finished work.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Create a series of experimental studies exploring the design process. Annotate your process. | Research an artist or designer who works with the design process. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own | Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with the design process. Which approaches were most successful and why?
